name: tetrahydrozoline + zinc sulfate unspecified form
purpose: Active ingredients Purpose Tetrahydrozoline HCl 0.05% Redness reliever Zinc sulfate 0.25% Astringent
uses: Use for temporary relief of discomfort and redness of the eye due to minor eye irritations
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have narrow angle glaucoma. Stop use and ask a doctor if you feel eye pain changes in vision occur redness or irritation of the eye lasts condition worsens or lasts more than 72 hours
